entities.summary: Shirshendu Mukhopadhyay is a Bengali author from India. He has written stories for both adults and children. He is known for creating the relatively new fictional sleuths Barodacharan and Shabor Dasgupta. Shirshendu Mukhopadhyay was a authors & novelists from Mymensingh (b. 1935-11-02, Mymensingh). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
